Ruling: second transcription right in part; proposed finding (the box changes no amount). i2441 p. 3, Column (c): "Check the box in column (c) if the qualifying person listed in column (a) was over age 12 at the time the care was provided and was disabled." The project checks the box for every qualifying person not able to care for themselves except a qualifying child under 13 all year (`dependent.dc_child_all_year` false), so a qualifying person under 13 who is not your qualifying child but qualifies through the disabled route (for example an unrelated child aged 10 who lived with you all year as a member of your household, your dependent as a qualifying relative, and not able to care for themselves) is checked though never over age 12; the second leaves it unchecked. Proposed fix: replace the `dependent.dc_child_all_year == false` test with the age, `dependent.age` not less than `dc.child_age` (13 or over at the end of 2025). The second also leaves the box unchecked for a disabled qualifying child who turned 13 in 2025 (its note); there the project is retained: care given after the 13th birthday was given while the child was over age 12 and disabled, and column (c) adds "A person over age 12 at the time the care was provided must be physically or mentally incapable of caring for themselves to be listed on line 2", which is that child's position for that care. Fixed during integration (BUG-0080): `dependent.dc_line2c` now tests the person's age against `dc.child_age` (13) instead of `dependent.dc_child_all_year`.
